Searched the glossary entries at lines 16-22. There is no C4, DSL or Structurizr entry.

Checked both diagrams. Prose follows the container diagram at line 104 ("O usuário fala só com a API..."). Prose follows the sequence diagram at line 127 ("A confirmação ao usuário acontece logo depois do enfileiramento...").

Searched the document for figures. It contains only 30s, about 12%, 50 mil linhas, 100 mil linhas and the weekly ticket, all from the user. The other numbers are dates and counts, not metrics. Unknown values (link validity, retention, retries) appear as open questions at lines 172-201.
Line 24 "## Visão geral". Paragraph 1 (line 26): "Hoje a API gera os relatórios...". Paragraph 2 (line 28): "O custo aceito é que o usuário perde o download imediato...". That is two paragraphs.

Searched lines 24-28. There is no schema, payload, endpoint or retry policy. The only number is the existing gateway's 30s timeout, which is stated as the problem from the user, not as a configuration of the design.

Searched the document and the DSL. The technologies named are RabbitMQ, S3, CSV, XLSX and e-mail, all from the user. The DSL container descriptions name only RabbitMQ and S3. The e-mail system has no technology. Structurizr and Mermaid are documentation notation, not system technology.

Line 104: "O worker consome o job, escreve o arquivo no S3 enquanto o gera e, ao terminar, aciona o envio do e-mail." The DSL also has "worker -> email \"Pede o envio do link assinado\"". The user never said which component triggers the e-mail. Line 127 even notes that who sends it is undefined.
